title: The Late Bus
introduction: داستان را بخوان و به فعل‌های گذشته ساده و عبارت‌های مربوط به زمان توجه کن.
paragraphs: It is Monday morning. Tom is waiting for the bus, but it is late. He looks at his watch. It is already eight fifteen.
An old man is standing near him. “Is this the bus to the city center?” Tom asks. “Yes, it is,” the man says. “But today it is running late.”
A few minutes later, the bus arrives. Tom helps the old man get on the bus. They find two seats and sit down.
“Thank you for your help,” the man says. Tom smiles. “You’re welcome. Have a nice day!”
